reading_note: The arc traces how the awakening Call of divine truth descends through discrete degrees into the scattered goods of the Living Soul (the spiritual life held captive in the natural mind). The teaching uses the body-and-head correspondence: the First Man is the inmost celestial good, the head from which all life flows; his members are the affections and truths dispersed below. So long as the head remains conjoined to the Pillar of Glory (the axis of ascent), life flows even into damaged members. The five faculties (nous, ennoia, etc.) are sent forth as discrete degrees of reception that awaken trapped light, draw the soul back inward, and restore it to its place in the image of the Father. The arc: descent of the Call → recognition of dispersion → conjunction of head to Pillar → sending of faculties → gathering and reintegration.
